title: Orbiting pinion and pin in a radial output slot
question: Drive H CW. Determine the motion of J (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive H CW. External mesh S/P (16/16 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S positive, P negative. Internal mesh P/R (16/48 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P negative, R held. R is locked to the frame. R held. Add pin spin times its offset (24) to the moving axle speed (carrier rate times 32). The radial output slot takes this tangential sum. P negative, H positive, J negative. 16 × (S − H) + 16 × (P − H) = 0. 16 × (P − H) − 48 × (R − H) = 0. The requested motion is CCW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: B
options.explanation: J must be CCW. Add pin spin times its offset (24) to the moving axle speed (carrier rate times 32). The radial output slot takes this tangential sum. P negative, H positive, J negative..
